name: stbimage
description: A single compiled instantiation of stb_image and stb_image_write so that linking both into the same program does not produce a duplicate-symbol/ODR conflict. See https://github.com/sgct/stbimage for details.

This package exports three CMake targets: unofficial::stbimage::stbimage (declarations only), unofficial::stbimage::stbimage-read-impl (compiled stb_image read functions), and unofficial::stbimage::stbimage-write-impl (compiled stb_image_write functions). The read and write implementations are split so a program that already links another stb_image read implementation (e.g. assimp) can link only the write half. See usage for details.
